query: SELECT root_id FROM thread_watches WHERE reader_key=? AND active=1 UNION SELECT threads.root_id FROM topic_watches topic_watch JOIN board_messages roots ON roots.topic_id=topic_watch.topic_id AND roots.root_id IS NULL JOIN board_threads threads ON threads.root_id=roots.message_id WHERE topic_watch.reader_key=? AND topic_watch.active=1 ORDER BY root_id
